references.text: Jesus' disciples also feared being expelled from the synagogue because of their open faith in him, reflecting the same fear of the Jews that prevented open speech.
Many believed in Jesus, but out of fear of the religious leaders they refused to confess it openly, just as no one spoke openly about him in chapter 7.
Joseph of Arimathea was a secret disciple who did not want to be expelled, and Nicodemus also came fearing discovery, mirroring the fear of the Jews that hindered open preaching.
Jesus warns that they will expel you from the synagogue, a fear that underlay why no one spoke openly about him earlier.
The religious leaders had ordered that anyone who knew where Jesus was should report it, creating an atmosphere of fear and secrecy.
